newsitem.title: USA: Maine gov says still working out tax cap details.
newsitem.headline: Maine gov says still working out tax cap details.

text.p: Maine Gov plans to propose a tax cap mechanism he said will hold down both state and local spending, but added he still is working out the details of how to keep taxes from rising and not infringe local control.
He said it does no good for the state to cut spending if local governments increase spending and local taxes to pay for that spending.
King says he is still working out the details of how to hold down taxes and spending and not infringe on local control.
